Hi Samantha / Tom —

Thanks again for the call today — good to meet you both. Quick recap and proposed next steps so procurement has what it needs to proceed: 

Recap
- We discussed Redwood Inference for low-latency LLM inference (hosted + option for Dedicated later).
- Technical follow-up (SE) owner: Aditya Rao (cc'ed) for integration questions and perf targets.
- Commercial: Acme prefers PO-based billing; looking to confirm payment terms and vendor onboarding requirements.

Requested docs / items we will provide (attached)
- Formal quote/order form (attached: Redwood_Quote_Acme_20260715.pdf)
- W-9 (attached: Redwood_W9_20260715.pdf)
- Standard insurance certificate (stub attached for vendor setup)
- Standard Redwood terms & SSLA link included in the quote doc

Clarifying questions for your procurement team
1) Payment method: you mentioned PO — can you confirm net terms (e.g., Net30)?
2) Vendor setup: what contact/email should we send vendor paperwork to (AP/vendor@acme or invoices@acme)?
3) Marketplace: does Acme require vendors to be listed in AWS Marketplace or can we run via direct PO/invoice?
4) Timeline: what’s your target date for PO issuance?

Next steps
- I’ll loop Aditya for any technical clarifications.
- Dev (Sales Ops) will prepare a vendor packet if PO is preferred.
- Weekly check-in cadence from me until PO is received (unless you prefer a different cadence).

Attachments: Redwood_Quote_Acme_20260715.pdf; Redwood_W9_20260715.pdf; insurance_certificate_stub.pdf

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme — procurement next steps and docs (recap)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and docs. Quick answers from procurement: 
- We do PO only for new vendors; standard terms are Net30.
- Please send vendor setup packet to procurement@acme.com. Our AP team will request the invoice to be sent to invoices@acme.com once vendor is active.
- We generally prefer vendors to be listed in AWS Marketplace but it is not strictly required — the decision is legal/ops-driven depending on the size of the contract. For now PO is fine.

Outstanding items for us to proceed:
1) Formal quote with line items and total (we have the PDF you attached but prefer a quote that includes PO/contract reference).
2) Completed vendor packet (W-9 is fine; also need proof of insurance and vendor banking details or remit instructions).

Who should I expect to hear from for the vendor packet? Can you provide an estimated time to have the updated quote + packet?

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Senior Procurement Manager | Acme Corp
procurement@acme.com
